God grants wisdom to whom He wills; receiving wisdom is great good. Proverbs 2:6 is a broad staged wisdom-gift comparison, not evidence of direct dependence.

Whatever is spent or vowed is known to God; wrongdoers have no helpers. No passage-specific parallel established; Proverbs 11:24–25 concerns generosity/recompense and is too weak for a direct association.
